attchmntText: Monitoring agency Report for Quarter Ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited submitted a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of equity shares. The issue size was revised to Rs 300.48 crore due to under-subscription, involving 2,07,23,000 shares at Rs 145 per share. The Board of Directors approved the revised allocation on September 10, 2026. During the quarter, Rs 274.54 crore was utilized. Rs 192.48 crore was used for working capital requirements. Rs 7.24 crore was spent on capital expenditure for plant and machinery at Dhule, Maharashtra. Rs 74.82 crore was utilized for general corporate purposes. Unutilized proceeds of Rs 25.94 crore were invested in mutual funds and monitoring accounts. The monitoring agency confirmed no material deviations from the offer document.

attchmntText: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited filed a statement of deviation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from its preferential issue. Funds were raised on 10-09-2026, with a total amount of 300,48,35000. The monitoring agency is CRISIL Ratings Limited. The company raised 317.48 crore originally, but the modified allocation was 300.48 crore due to under-subscription. Utilization stands at 274.54 crore. Specific allocations included 50.00 crore for capital expenditure, with 33.00 crore allocated and 7.24 crore utilized. Working capital requirements had an allocation of 192.48 crore, fully utilized. General corporate purposes had an allocation of 75.00 crore, with 74.82 crore utilized. The Audit Committee and auditors raised no comments.

attchmntText: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Adoption of new line(s) of business
desc: Adoption of new line(s) of business
voiceSummary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited adopted a new line of business effective 14th November 2026. The Board approved this decision on 14th November 2026. The new activity involves undertaking commission agency mandates. This leverages the company's established network. The estimated investment is Nil. The transaction is strictly fee-based. It utilizes existing office infrastructure. The company expects revenue and profit growth from this activity. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited held a Board Meeting on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the minutes of the last meeting. The Board also approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results were reviewed by the audit committee. A Limited Review Report was furnished by the Statutory Auditors. The financial results and the report are attached to the announcement.

voiceSummary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has intimated the schedule for an earnings call regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The virtual conference is scheduled for November 17, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST. Management participants include Mr. Pankaj Ostwal, Mr. Sourabh Gupta, and Mr. Pukhraj Kanther. Dial-in numbers are provided for domestic and international access.
